text:
You need a clean, user-friendly maid housekeeping website built from scratch, with a strong visual identity, clear communication, and an initial launch within your 2-month timeframe.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack web developer with 7 years of experience building modern web applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I’d be a strong fit for turning your ideas and goals into a polished website that reflects your branding and values while staying organized and easy to manage throughout the process.

For Ferrylane Freight, I built a live fleet dashboard using React, Socket.IO, Node.js, Redis, and Mapbox. It showed a dispatcher map with every truck’s position and ETA, and pushed GPS updates to the browser as they arrived. The result was 1,800 trucks tracked live with under 2 seconds from ping to screen. That project required careful coordination, fast iteration, and clear handling of real-time data—skills that translate well to a project like yours where communication and steady progress matter.

For your housekeeping website, I’d focus on creating a clean structure, intuitive navigation, and an aesthetic that communicates professionalism, trust, and quality. I’m comfortable taking existing concepts and turning them into a functional site that matches your goals, while working closely with you through regular check-ins on Google Meet, Teams, or your preferred communication tool. Since you’ll be providing guidance and feedback along the way, I can stay aligned with your vision and make sure the design and development stay on track.

I also value detail and organization, which is important for making sure the launch is smooth and the final product feels refined. If you’d like, I can help shape the site’s structure, user flow, and presentation so it’s ready for a strong initial release within the timeline you’ve outlined.

I’d be glad to discuss your ideas and help bring this website to life.
